title: Gap-closure pre-registration: Yeast 4825 outcome coupling, GitHub 992, Digital swarm
follows: cohort-audit PR #112 (two declared gaps, two simulations) and knowledge PR #111 (falsification locked)

honesty_disclosure.type: CONFIRMATORY reproduction pre-registration, NOT a blind discovery
honesty_disclosure.statement: The yeast outcome-coupling values (CV AUC linear ~0.67 / quadratic ~0.61, and the non-converged multivariate artifact at ~0.49) and the PyPI dependency-graph values were OBSERVED EARLIER IN THIS SESSION on 2026-07-10/12 before this spec was written. Declaring them blind would be false. The value of locking them here is that the predicted numbers are fixed BEFORE the reproduction script is written, so the script cannot be tuned to produce them, and any deviation is visible. Bands are stated as intervals, not point-fits.

Y1_labels_join.claim: committed ORF-keyed essentiality labels join to the STRING-derived channel
Y1_labels_join.can_fail: yes - ORF key mismatch, wrong taxon, or truncated label file would break the join

Y2_channel_intact.claim: the two fidelity hops remain independent on the rebuilt cohort
Y2_channel_intact.can_fail: yes - a collapsed channel would void the coupling test

Y3_quadratic_not_better.claim: the quadratic term does NOT beat the linear term out-of-sample
Y3_quadratic_not_better.can_fail: yes - the quadratic could win, which would overturn the linear law on this cohort

Y4_published_047_is_an_artifact.claim: the published 'quadratic AUC ~0.47, anti-predictive' does NOT reproduce under a converged fit; it was a separation-degenerate multivariate artifact
Y4_published_047_is_an_artifact.predicted: single-term quadratic CV AUC >= 0.55 (i.e. ABOVE chance, contradicting 0.47) AND the multivariate U+D+D^2 logit reports converged == False
Y4_published_047_is_an_artifact.can_fail: yes - if the converged fit also returns ~0.47, the published number stands and this prediction is wrong

G1_992_cannot_be_closed_offline.claim: the N=992 cohort cannot be reconstructed from committed data or refetched within rate limits
G1_992_cannot_be_closed_offline.predicted: no committed 992-row labelled artifact exists; the gap REMAINS OPEN
G1_992_cannot_be_closed_offline.can_fail: yes - if a 992-row labelled artifact is found committed, this prediction is wrong and the gap closes
G1_992_cannot_be_closed_offline.note: refetching 992 repos needs ~2 API calls each at 60 req/hr unauthenticated (~33 h); not attempted

G2_expanded_labelled_cohort.claim: unioning every committed real tau_v dataset yields a larger labelled cohort than the 21 rows the audit found
G2_expanded_labelled_cohort.predicted: N_union >= 35 AND n_failed >= 8 AND median tau_v(failed) > median tau_v(survived)
G2_expanded_labelled_cohort.can_fail: yes - the direction could reverse, or the union could stay at 21

S1_swarm_is_simulation.claim: the digital swarm remains a seeded simulation, not evidence
S1_swarm_is_simulation.predicted: source self-declares simulation; status stays SIMULATION
S1_swarm_is_simulation.can_fail: NO - this is a provenance check, not a test. Recorded as a label, never counted as support.

S2_swarm_real_data_analogue.claim: the swarm's substantive claim (linear >= quadratic on a dependency network) is testable on a REAL dependency graph
S2_swarm_real_data_analogue.predicted: on the 434-package PyPI graph, quadratic does NOT improve out-of-sample CV AUC over U+D (delta <= +0.01)
S2_swarm_real_data_analogue.can_fail: yes - the quadratic could improve, refuting the swarm's claim on real data

pre_committed_consequences.if_Y3_fails: the linear law is overturned on the yeast cohort and must be retracted for this substrate
pre_committed_consequences.if_Y4_fails: the published AUC 0.47 stands and my artifact diagnosis is withdrawn
pre_committed_consequences.if_G2_direction_reverses: the tau_v law is reported as unsupported on the expanded committed cohort
pre_committed_consequences.if_S2_fails: the swarm's linear claim is refuted on real data and must not be cited

scope_limits_declared_in_advance: Closing Y1-Y4 makes the yeast OUTCOME COUPLING offline-reproducible; it does NOT make the GitHub 992 cohort reproducible.
G2 raises power but does NOT reach N=992; the 992 claim stays uncitable as offline-reproducible.
S1 is a label, not evidence. Only S2 carries falsifiable weight for the swarm's claim.
The yeast essentiality labels are wet-lab DEG2001 data mapped to systematic ORFs via BioGRID; essentiality is never derived from topology (non-circular).
